in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joyful, Dainty, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rushita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rushita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Rushit’, meaning ‘joyful, dainty, delight’. This name is often given to a baby girl born under the full moon or during the Navratri festival.
